posts.name: Phantom5613
posts.cooked:
I think that all of them have awesome new looks. I especially like AZ's costume change, it adds in some much needed color but you can still tell it's him. I'm getting a 'Knight in Shining Armor' vibe from Bunker, especially with the golden highlights. Interesting how Tachyon is going more blue/white than red/white in her costume, guess she's going more for team colors. Wraith is adding more color into her suit as well, hopefully she can still bend in to the shadows. Though I guess if she was able to blend with the white bandages and all that, this won't have any problem. Legacy is keeping his classic look which is a good idea. And last but not least Unity has left behind the 'grease monkey' look for something more like a super suit, still rocking with the pink.

 

Over all I like the new looks. I'm excited to start reading and see what other visual changes may have happened to other heroes! :D

posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked:
That's true, she left the team to go work at RevoCorp.

I like AZ's new outfit, more colorful and sans that silly triangle faceplate.  Interesting that Unity adopted the same outfit in the RPG as in Tactics (although the belt buckle is different, of course).  I like Tachyon's color scheme, but those goggles are ridiculous.  Bunker is... interesting, "Sentai" is definitely a good word for it.  Legacy and Wraith look about the same.

The other weird thing is the position of "The Roleplaying Game" speech bubble.  It overlaps Legacy's head, so my first take on it was that he was the one saying those words, which broke the 4th wall.  Of course, it's also weird that the letter S should be saying them.
